summary: The community.general yaml callback plugin will be removed in 12.0.0, earlier than planned, because it relies on ansible-core internals that change heavily from 2.19.
questions: Is the community.general yaml callback going away?
When will the yaml stdout callback be removed?

answer_card.title: yaml callback removal
answer_card.answer_md: The `community.general.yaml` callback will be removed in community.general 12.0.0 (moved up from 13.0.0) because it depends on ansible-core internals that change a lot since 2.19.
